title: A complaint proves an allegation was filed, not guilt
note: The filing is a genuine primary record. What makes it not proof is that what it contains is an allegation, so the assertion is typed as one.

claim.wording: Meridian Instruments Inc. knowingly falsified calibration records for the RX-9 sensor between 2023 and 2025.

assertions.quote: Plaintiff alleges that defendant knowingly falsified calibration records for the RX-9 sensor between 2023 and 2025
assertions.scope: civil matters within the Northern District
